pm-review-skill 0.1.0

- Initial release of a product manager’s page review tool.
- Supports page review via URL or design screenshot.
- Provides professional 7-dimension evaluation reports (strategy, UX, functionality, metrics, tech, competition, operations).
- Includes dedicated deep-dive reviews: color (six-level model), typography, interaction, accessibility (six-level model), security (seven-level model), and performance (seven-level model).
- Features fallback flows and tool prioritization for different review methods.
- Outputs issue categorization, three solution sets, prioritization matrix, and measurable success indicators.
